page.overview:
Who is Spencer?

Spencer is the intelligence officer of the former Roger Pirates.

Spencer is an average-sized man with light skin, and red wavy hair tied in a ponytail, with an even fringe and two strands framing his face. During his travels with the Roger Pirates, he wore a yellow shirt with an olive green jacket with several styled patches on the left arm, dark red pants with a brown haramaki, flat dark-colored shoes, and sometimes a sword on his hip.

Not much is known about Spencer's personality, but he was shown joyfully partaking in his crew activities. He, like the rest of the crew, seemed to admire Shakuyaku and was very angry when they had to give her up to Silvers Rayleigh, protecting them both during their escape from the Marines and other pirates.

As a member of the Roger Pirates, Spencer is likely a formidable fighter and pirate. His occupation as an intelligence officer also implies he is skilled in espionage, as well as having the necessary analytical expertise and assessment skills to properly perform his job.
